script: I can't believe this mentally ill woman exposed our hotel's deadly secret.. I was at the front desk, juggling a line of guests, when a corporate group checked in—big block of rooms, meeting space, the whole "high profile" package. The hotel runs on a skeleton crew during the day; management loves slashing labor costs so hard that there's literally no daytime security. If something goes down, whoever's around—manager or not—just handles it. In the middle of their meeting, a mentally ill woman slipped onto the elevator, climbed up to the convention space, crashed into their session for a minute, then vanished. I never saw her because the elevators are just outside my peripheral vision; I was too busy helping guests. Nobody from the group bothered to tell the front desk while it was happening. They finished their meeting, then marched over to complain like it was a national crisis. I was the only one there, so they started interrogating me about security. I kept it short: "I am sorry this happened. If something like that happens again, let your banquet contact or someone on staff know right away so we can respond." One white Karen-looking businesswoman scoffed, "Our CEO was there and could have been hurt, like that CEO who got shot." She was obviously referencing Luigi's. That comment hit me like a punch in the face. My first thought: "Why? Is your CEO a piece of shit like the one who got shot?" The irony was thick. This group couldn't even book through their own link; they used third parties to dodge the group rate, tried to bring in outside food despite a clause that said no, and were constantly trying to nickel and dime every little thing. It felt like they either never read the agreement or thought the rules didn't apply to them. I don't get how people like that end up in positions where they can act like they're the big shots. They project importance and success, yet they can't follow basic instructions, expect everyone else to fix their messes, and always look for ways to cut corners. (Literally insane.)
